name: the target row is never stamped
why: The attribute is the only thing that survives the multi-table clones; without it MusicBrainz's :target highlight is simply gone after 'Show all Tracks'.

name: the target tint loses !important
why: Recorded as a guard the spec cannot see: the :not() exclusions already lift the selector above MusicBrainz's zebra rule, and the row is stamped BEFORE render, so the per-cell inline rest/sticky background the script captures from the computed style is already the tint. The !important only matters if something later writes an inline background onto a targeted cell.

name: the targeted row is never scrolled to
why: Track 22 of 25 sits below the fold; the highlight is useless if nobody sees it.

name: the target tint paints over warning flags
why: A flagged cell's tint is the more urgent message; the exclusions keep it.

name: the release-tracks matcher rejects /disc/<n>
why: Then the /disc/1 page gets no 'Show all Tracks' button at all.

name: the /disc/<n> @include is missing
why: Tampermonkey would never inject the script on a /disc/<n> URL.
